name: Toj Osen'ju
source:
What do you do when you’ve been turned into a cat and you want your human body back? That's right, find some kids and teach them magic!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221224204859/http://yourstoryinteractive.com/en/projects/that-autumn]Official website[/url]]
translation:
当你变成猫并且想要恢复人类身体时你会做什么？没错，找一些孩子，教他们魔法！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221224204859/http://yourstoryinteractive.com/en/projects/that-autumn]官方网站[/url]]
